svg.title: Runtime binding by execution mode
svg.desc: Four execution modes share the Registry authority boundary. The diagram distinguishes mandatory and conditional ALE, Graph, L5, and recording requirements.
svg.text: Figure 5 · Runtime binding by execution mode
One approved Registry and authority contract; Resolver does not invent or reclassify modes
Approved Profile Registry / Runtime Resolver
Resolve authorized Profile and bindings; verify eligibility and retain the selected mode.
human-only
Purpose / owner / human_work_profile / authority_refs / evidence requirements
Context when needed; ALE and L5 are not required.
Pin Profile and Binding digests in HumanWorkRecord.
interactive-agent
shared_execution_profile / harness_ref / context_profile / authority_refs / Human control
L5 required; Human / Client controls outer iteration. ALE is not implied.
Pin Profile and Binding digests in the L5 Execution Request.
agentic
ALE L2 entry / L4 Loop / shared_execution_profile / harness_ref / context_profile / authority_refs
L3 Graph only when used; L5 required when an Agent executes.
Pin Profile and Binding digests in the L2 RuntimeManifest.
deterministic-system
Executor revision / scope / evidence / verification / SystemExecutionRecord
ALE and L5 not required; explicit L5 mediation is optional.
Correlate Profile and Binding digests with SystemExecutionRecord.
Human-required Work MUST NOT be reclassified as agentic or deterministic-system.
Summary only; requirements and references follow Contract §10 and Registry §§14 / 21.
